questions.question_text: The pentagons $PQRST \sim VWXYZ$ are similar. Which side of the second pentagon corresponds to side $RS$?

options.why: Shifted one position too early — $R$ is the third letter, so it matches $X$, not $W$.
Shifted one position too late — $S$ is the fourth letter, so it matches $Y$, making $RS$ correspond to $XY$.
Takes the first two letters of the second name regardless of position; the letters must be matched position by position.

questions.solution_text:
$R$ is the third letter and $S$ is the fourth, so they match $X$ and $Y$.
Side $RS$ corresponds to side $XY$.

questions.question_text: Given $\triangle FGH \sim \triangle RST$, which angle of $\triangle RST$ corresponds to $\angle GHF$?

options.why: Uses the second triangle's name in its written order instead of applying the letter map $G\to S$, $H\to T$, $F\to R$ to each letter of $\angle GHF$.
Pairs the letters back-to-front ($F\to T$, $G\to S$, $H\to R$), putting the vertex at $R$ instead of $T$.

questions.solution_text:
Matching the letters: $F\leftrightarrow R$, $G\leftrightarrow S$, $H\leftrightarrow T$.
The vertex of $\angle GHF$ is $H$, which matches $T$.
$\angle GHF$ corresponds to $\angle STR$.

questions.question_text: Two similar quadrilaterals satisfy $\angle A=\angle W$, $\angle B=\angle X$, $\angle C=\angle Y$ and $\angle D=\angle Z$. Which similarity statement is correct?

options.why: Lists the second quadrilateral in reverse, pairing $\angle A$ with $\angle Z$ although $\angle A=\angle W$.
Starts correctly at $W$ but then travels the wrong way around, pairing $\angle B$ with $\angle Z$ instead of $\angle X$.
Reorders the first quadrilateral without reordering the second, pairing $\angle B$ with $\angle W$ although $\angle B=\angle X$.

questions.solution_text:
The given angle pairs are $A\leftrightarrow W$, $B\leftrightarrow X$, $C\leftrightarrow Y$, $D\leftrightarrow Z$, so the vertices are written in exactly that order.
$\therefore ABCD \sim WXYZ$

questions.question_text: The pentagons $ABCDE \sim TUVWX$ are similar. Which side of the second pentagon corresponds to side $AE$?

options.why: Takes the first two letters of the second name; $A$ matches $T$, but $E$ is the last letter and matches $X$.
Treats the side as $DE$ — $D$ matches $W$, but the side asked for is $AE$, joining the first and last vertices.

questions.solution_text:
$A$ is the first letter and $E$ is the last, so they match $T$ and $X$.
Side $AE$ corresponds to side $TX$.
